####################################################################################################
Purpose of script: To check the model results and plot it 
####################################################################################################

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
source("../00_pck.R")
source("fun_checkgaps.R")
source("fun_condeffects.R")
source("fun_ampphi.R")
library(colorspace)
library(viridis)
library(ggridges)

theme_set(theme_classic() + theme(strip.background = element_blank()))

imm_tidy_names <- data.frame(
  imm_name = c("measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv", 
               "pertupt", "pertufha", "pertuprn", "dipht", "tetan", 
               "polio1", "polio2", "polio3", "mena", "menc", "meny"),
  imm_name_tidy = c("Measles", "Mumps", "Rubella", "Varicella", 
                    "Diphteria", "Tetanus", "Pertussis PT", "Pertussis FHA", "Pertussis PRN",
                    "Polio 1", "Polio 2", "Polio 3", 
                    "N. meningitidis A", "N. meningitidis C", "N. meningitidis Y"))
```

# Raw data 
```{r}
# Read in the waic (only models that converged)
waic_df <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/all_waic.rds"))
# Read in min waic
waic_minbest <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/all_waic_minbest.rds"))
# Read in data gaps
all_datagaps <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/all_datagaps.rds"))
# Read in conditional effects 
all_ceffects <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/all_ceffects.rds"))
# Read in coefcosine
all_coefcosine <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$outputs}/all_coefcosine.rds"))

df_converged <- filter(waic_df, dat == "s08", mod_out == "imm", str_detect(mod_name, "cs")) %>%
  # The function needs arguments reg (NA for cs and "reg_x" for csi) and multi (multi pat)
  mutate(reg = case_when(str_detect(mod_name, "csi") ~ str_remove_all(mod_name, "csi_")), 
         multi = str_detect(pat, "multi"))
```

# Define main analyses 
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", 
             "hib", "menc", "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")
```

# Samples amplitude and phase ======================================================================
```{r}
all_samplescosine <- pomp::bake(file = glue("{dirs$outputs}/all_samples.rds"), dir = "", {
  # Read in the coeficients 
  sapply(df_converged$mod, function(x) {
    readRDS(glue("{dirs$samples}/samples_{x}")) %>%
      mutate(sam_no = row_number()) %>%
      pivot_longer(-sam_no, names_to = "parameter", values_to = "Estimate") %>%
      # Coefficients of the cosinor only 
      filter(str_detect(parameter, "cos|sin"))
  }, simplify = FALSE) %>%
    bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
    # From mod to variables (pat, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, reg, multi)
    left_join(df_converged, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
    # From param to variables (param, imm_name, clu) -----------------------------------------------
    mutate(
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, "b_|pi_vac_week_v1|:"),
      regtemp = replace_na(reg, "regtemp"),
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, regtemp),
      param = str_extract(parameter, "cos|sin"),
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, param),
      param = paste0("p_", param),
      imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
      parameter = str_remove_all(parameter, paste0("immvals1anti", imm_name, "_")),
      clu = case_when(str_detect(reg, "reg_2") & parameter == "" ~ "1_North",
                      str_detect(reg, "reg_3|reg_4|reg_6") & parameter == "" ~ "1_Temperate",
                      !is.na(reg) & parameter != "" ~ parameter)) %>%
    select(sam_no, pat, mod, param, mod_name, reg, clu, imm_name, Estimate, mod_out, dat, vac, gauss, 
           pat_tidy, multi) %>%
    # Estimate amplitude and phase -----------------------------------------------------------------
    pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>%
    mutate(sam_amp = fun_amp(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin),
           sam_phi = fun_phi(p_cos = p_cos, p_sin = p_sin)) %>%
    # Add mean estimates ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(distinct(all_coefcosine, mod, clu, imm_name, p_cos_mean, p_sin_mean, amp_mean, 
                       phi_mean, checkgaps_all), by = join_by(mod, clu, imm_name)) %>%
    # Add imm_name tidy names ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    left_join(imm_tidy_names, by = join_by(imm_name))
  })
```

# Check the meaning of the confidence intervals with the samples
```{r}
all_samplescosine %>%
  filter(mod == "bmvl_s08_rota_cs.rds") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = sam_phi)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 52) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = phi_mean), color = "blue") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(sam_phi)), color = "grey") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = quantile(sam_phi, 0.975)), color = "grey") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = quantile(sam_phi, 0.025)), color = "grey") + 
all_samplescosine %>%
  filter(mod == "bmv1_s08_hav_cs.rds") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = exp(sam_amp))) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 52) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), color = "red", linetype = "dotted") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = exp(amp_mean)), color = "blue") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = median(exp(sam_amp))), color = "grey") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = quantile(exp(sam_amp), 0.975)), color = "grey") + 
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = quantile(exp(sam_amp), 0.025)), color = "grey") 
```

# Plot of the phase 
```{r}
datpl_l <- sapply(sort(unique(filter(all_samplescosine, reg == "reg_6", pat %in% pat_sel)$clu)),
                  function(x) {
  all_samplescosine %>%
    filter(reg == "reg_6", pat %in% pat_sel, checkgaps_all == FALSE) %>%
    mutate(clu_tidy = factor(clu, labels = c("Temperate", "Subtropical", "Tropical", "Tropical south", 
                             "Subtropical south"))) %>%
    filter(clu == x) %>%
    distinct(mod, pat, clu, clu_tidy, imm_name, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, 
             sam_phi, sam_amp, phi_mean, amp_mean, imm_name_tidy, sam_no) %>%
    group_by(pat, clu, clu_tidy) %>%
    mutate(phi_group = case_when((phi_mean >= 51 | phi_mean < 11.25) ~ "1st Quarter",
                                 (phi_mean >= 11.25 & phi_mean < 24.5) ~ "2nd Quarter",
                                 (phi_mean >= 24.5 & phi_mean < 37.75) ~ "3th Quarter",
                                 (phi_mean >= 37.75 & phi_mean < 51) ~ "4th Quarter"),
           phi_group = factor(phi_group, levels = c("1st Quarter", "2nd Quarter", "3th Quarter", "4th Quarter")),
           sam_phi = round(sam_phi))
}, simplify = FALSE)

datpl_l
```


```{r}
pl <- lapply(datpl_l, function(datpl) {
  # Obtain proportions per phi
  datpl <- datpl %>%
    group_by(pat, clu, clu_tidy, pat_tidy, phi_group, phi_mean, sam_phi) %>%
    summarise(tot = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(pat, clu) %>%
    mutate(tot = tot/sum(tot)) %>%
    ungroup()
  # Plot it
  datpl %>%
    distinct(pat, clu, clu_tidy, pat_tidy, phi_mean, phi_group) %>%
    crossing(sam_phi = 1:52) %>%
    left_join(datpl, by = join_by(pat, clu, clu_tidy, pat_tidy, phi_mean, phi_group, sam_phi)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = sam_phi, y = reorder(pat_tidy, -as.numeric(phi_group)), fill = phi_mean)) +
      geom_tile(aes(alpha = tot), color = "grey") + 
      scale_alpha_continuous("Proportion of phases", na.value = 0, range = c(0.01, 1)) +
      scale_fill_gradientn("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52),
                           colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"),
                                       rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C")))) +
      facet_grid(.~clu_tidy, space = "free", scales = "free") + 
      scale_x_continuous("Phase", expand = c(0,0)) +
      scale_y_discrete("") + 
      theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
            legend.position = "none",
            strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0))
})

pl_leg <- ggpubr::get_legend(pl[[3]] + theme(legend.position = "top"))

pl_phi <- pl[[1]] + pl[[2]] + pl[[3]] + pl[[4]] + pl[[5]] + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(14,5,13,1,4))

pl_phi
```

# Plot it
pl <- test %>%
    distinct(pat, clu, clu_tidy, pat_tidy, phi_mean, phi_group) %>%
    crossing(sam_phi = 1:52) %>%
    left_join(test, by = join_by(pat, clu, clu_tidy, pat_tidy, phi_mean, phi_group, sam_phi)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = sam_phi, y = reorder(pat_tidy, -as.numeric(phi_group)), fill = phi_mean)) +
      geom_tile(aes(alpha = tot), color = "grey") + 
      scale_alpha_continuous("Proportion of phases", na.value = 0, range = c(0.01, 1),
                             breaks = c(0.01, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3)) +
      scale_fill_gradientn("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52),
                           colours = c(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C"),
                                       rev(viridis(100, begin = 0, option = "C")))) +
      facet_grid(clu_tidy~., space = "free", scales = "free") + 
      scale_x_continuous("Peak timing", breaks = c(1,18,35,52), limits = c(1,52), expand = c(0,0)) +
      scale_y_discrete("") + 
      guides(alpha = guide_legend(order = 1), fill = guide_colorbar(
        order = 2, theme = theme(
  legend.key.width  = unit(0.72, "npc"),
  legend.key.height = unit(0.015, "npc")))) + 
      theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0),
            strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0),
            legend.position = "top",
            legend.justification = "right",
            legend.box = "vertical")
ggsave(pl, file = "../figures/test.pdf", width = 10, height = 8)

# Plot of the amplitude
```{r}
col_amp <- viridis(14)
names(col_amp) <- (filter(all_samplescosine, checkgaps == FALSE, reg == "reg_6", pat %in% pat_sel, 
                          clu == "1_Temperate") %>%
  distinct(pat_tidy, amp_mean) %>%
  arrange(amp_mean))$pat_tidy

pl <- list()
for(i in sort(unique(filter(all_samplescosine, checkgaps == FALSE, reg == "reg_6", pat %in% pat_sel)$clu))) {
  pl[[i]] <- all_samplescosine %>%
    filter(checkgaps == FALSE, reg == "reg_6", pat %in% pat_sel) %>%
    mutate(clu_tidy = factor(clu, labels = c("Temperate", "Subtropical", "Tropical", "Tropical south", 
                            "Subtropical south"))) %>%
    filter(clu == i) %>%
    distinct(mod, pat, clu, clu_tidy, imm_name, mod_out, mod_name, dat, vac, gauss, pat_tidy, phi_mean, 
             amp_mean, pat_imm, persample_amp_emp, persample_phi_emp, imm_name_tidy, sam_mod) %>%
    group_by(pat, clu, clu_tidy) %>%
    mutate(phi_group = case_when((phi >= 51 | phi < 11.25) ~ "1st Quarter",
                                 (phi >= 11.25 & phi < 24.5) ~ "3nd Quarter",
                                 (phi >= 24.5 & phi < 37.75) ~ "4th Quarter",
                                 (phi >= 37.75 & phi < 51) ~ "2nd Quarter")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = persample_amp_emp, y = reorder(pat_tidy, amp), 
               color = reorder(pat_tidy, amp), fill = reorder(pat_tidy, amp))) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 1), color = "grey", linetype = "dotted") + 
    stat_density_ridges(quantile_lines = TRUE, quantiles = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), alpha = 0.7) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = col_amp, aesthetics = c("color", "fill")) + 
    facet_grid(.~clu_tidy, space = "free", scales = "free") + 
    scale_y_discrete("") + 
    scale_x_continuous("Amplitude") + 
    theme(legend.position = "none",
          strip.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0))
}

pl_amp <- pl[[1]] + pl[[2]] + pl[[3]] + pl[[4]] + pl[[5]] + 
  plot_layout(ncol = 1, heights = c(14,5,13,1,4))
```
